item.tib: gsang sngags ma rgyad rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i mngon rtogs thugs rje nyi ma'i 'od zer
item.coloph: de ltar gsang sngags ma rgyud kyi mngon rtogs thugs rje nyi ma'i 'od zer zhes bya ba rgyud 'grel dang gshen nyi ma'i phyag len gtsor bzung nas bstan pa'i mnga' bdag gshen ston gtsug phud 'od zer gyi zhabs rdul spyi bor len pa'i btsun pa rnam dag 'od zer gyis khri brtan nor bu'i rtse la sbyar ba dge legs 'phel//
